public_state.prompt: Rebuild the live scene in space, orientation, and time. Drag shards into place, flip inverted feeds, scrub every temporal offset to master, then hold SCENE SYNC.

rules.rotation: Select a tile and flip it 180 degrees when its fragment is inverted.
rules.space: Drag one tile onto another to swap their mosaic positions.
rules.sync: Hold scene sync continuously for roughly 700 ms after all seams stabilize.
rules.time: Scrub each selected shard onto the master chronograph so motion crosses every seam.
